description: In 2012, Scott ran on No Budget, No Pay, which would hold lawmakers accountable for working together to pass an on-time budget. He kept his promise in Congress, where he cosponsored the No Budget No Pay Act, which would stop Congressional pay after October 1 of any fiscal year if Congress failed to pass a budget on time.
